claim_verbatim: Any country that tries to build new capacity hits the same wall: China will undercut until the project breaks.
context: Additional to the first harvest of Return of Matter.
resolution_criterion: YES if by 2028-12-31 at least one Western primary copper smelter project that was publicly planned on 2026-01-09, or that took a development step after that date, is cancelled or suspended indefinitely, and the company or trade press cites Chinese price competition or TC/RC undercutting; NO if no such cancellation has occurred and at least one new Western smelter is still on its announced timetable.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if by 2028-12-31 at least one Western primary copper smelter project that was publicly planned on 2026-01-09, or that took a development step after that date, is cancelled or suspended indefinitely, and the company or trade press cites Chinese price competition or TC/RC undercutting; NO if no such cancellation has occurred and at least one new Western smelter is still on its announced timetable.
resolution_source_planned: Company releases; Fastmarkets or equivalent smelter coverage
mechanism: Chinese midstream pricing undercuts new Western smelters until the project breaks. The choke point is pricing strategy, not geology.
notes: Additional. No date in the sentence. Window fixed at end-2028. 'Any country' is scored on Western primary copper smelters, which is the subject of the paragraph.
